summary: IPv4 address validation for device provisioning
description:
As a provisioning service, I need to validate that an operator-supplied IPv4 address is well-formed before pushing it to a device, so that malformed addresses are rejected early.

The function validate_ipv4(address: str) -> bool must return True only for a valid dotted-quad IPv4 address and False otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: A valid address like '192.168.1.10' returns True.
The boundary values '0.0.0.0' and '255.255.255.255' return True.
An octet greater than 255 (e.g. '256.1.1.1') returns False.
Fewer or more than four octets (e.g. '1.2.3' or '1.2.3.4.5') returns False.
Octets with leading zeros (e.g. '192.168.01.1') return False.
Empty string, non-numeric octets, and surrounding whitespace return False.
flowchart_mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Receive address string] --> B{Split on '.'}
    B -->|not 4 parts| F[Return False]
    B -->|4 parts| C{For each octet}
    C -->|not all digits| F
    C -->|leading zero| F
    C -->|value > 255| F
    C -->|all octets valid| G[Return True]
